embeddedText:
User Story Name: Search flights by route and travel dates
User Story Description: As a traveler, I want to search flights using origin, destination, departure date, return date, and passenger count so that I can see eligible itineraries.

User Story Name: Filter and sort available itineraries
User Story Description: As a traveler, I want to filter by nonstop flights, cabin, departure time, and sort by price or duration so that I can narrow flight options.

User Story Name: Display fare family details
User Story Description: As a traveler, I want each itinerary to show fare family benefits and restrictions so that I can compare baggage, change, and refund conditions.

User Story Name: Create and update traveler profile
User Story Description: As a customer, I want to save traveler identity and contact details so that I do not need to re-enter them for every booking.

User Story Name: Store travel document information
User Story Description: As an international traveler, I want to securely maintain passport and travel-document details so that booking and check-in can validate required information.

User Story Name: Maintain special assistance preferences
User Story Description: As a traveler, I want to save wheelchair and assistance preferences so that eligible requests can be reused on future trips.

User Story Name: Authorize card payment during checkout
User Story Description: As a customer, I want my card payment authorized securely so that a valid booking can be created after successful payment.

User Story Name: Retry recoverable payment failures
User Story Description: As a customer, I want recoverable payment failures to be retried safely without duplicate charges so that checkout can complete reliably.

User Story Name: Generate booking confirmation and receipt
User Story Description: As a customer, I want a confirmation number and payment receipt after booking so that I have proof of purchase and itinerary details.

User Story Name: Display interactive aircraft seat map
User Story Description: As a traveler, I want to see available and occupied seats on the aircraft so that I can select an eligible seat.

User Story Name: Purchase preferred and extra-legroom seats
User Story Description: As a traveler, I want to purchase premium seat options with transparent pricing so that I can choose additional comfort.

User Story Name: Offer eligible cabin upgrades
User Story Description: As a traveler, I want to view available cabin upgrade offers so that I can upgrade my trip when inventory permits.

User Story Name: Validate online check-in eligibility
User Story Description: As a passenger, I want the system to determine whether I am eligible for online check-in so that restricted itineraries are handled correctly.

User Story Name: Complete passenger check-in
User Story Description: As a passenger, I want to confirm my details and check in for eligible flight segments so that I am marked ready for travel.

User Story Name: Generate digital boarding pass
User Story Description: As a checked-in passenger, I want a digital boarding pass with flight, seat, boarding group, and barcode information so that I can board the aircraft.

User Story Name: Purchase prepaid checked baggage
User Story Description: As a traveler, I want to add and pay for checked bags before departure so that I can prepare for airport bag drop.

User Story Name: Track baggage journey events
User Story Description: As a traveler, I want to see bag accepted, loaded, transferred, arrived, and carousel events so that I know the current status of my baggage.

User Story Name: Notify customers of baggage exceptions
User Story Description: As a traveler, I want notifications when my baggage is delayed or rerouted so that I can take appropriate action.

User Story Name: Display real-time flight status
User Story Description: As a traveler, I want current departure, arrival, gate, delay, and cancellation status so that I can plan my airport journey.

User Story Name: Send gate and schedule change notifications
User Story Description: As a traveler, I want push, email, or SMS alerts when my gate or schedule changes so that I do not miss important updates.

User Story Name: Manage notification preferences
User Story Description: As a customer, I want to choose notification channels and event types so that I receive only useful travel alerts.

User Story Name: Identify disrupted itineraries
User Story Description: As a traveler, I want the platform to detect cancellations, significant delays, and missed-connection risk so that recovery options can be offered.

User Story Name: Search alternate flights for disrupted customers
User Story Description: As a disrupted traveler, I want eligible alternate flights ranked by arrival time and connection quality so that I can recover my trip.

User Story Name: Confirm self-service rebooking
User Story Description: As a disrupted traveler, I want to confirm a replacement itinerary and receive updated travel documents so that I can continue my journey.

User Story Name: Calculate cancellation eligibility and refund amount
User Story Description: As a customer, I want cancellation rules and refundable amounts calculated from my fare so that I understand the financial impact before cancelling.

User Story Name: Initiate refund to original payment method
User Story Description: As a customer, I want eligible refunds returned to the original payment method so that cancelled travel is financially settled.

User Story Name: Track refund status and notify customer
User Story Description: As a customer, I want to see refund progress and receive completion notifications so that I know when money has been returned.

User Story Name: Link loyalty account to customer profile
User Story Description: As a loyalty member, I want to link my account to my traveler profile so that eligible travel activity is associated with my membership.

User Story Name: Earn loyalty points from completed travel
User Story Description: As a loyalty member, I want eligible points credited after travel so that my balance reflects completed flights.

User Story Name: Redeem loyalty rewards during booking
User Story Description: As a loyalty member, I want to redeem available points for eligible bookings so that I can reduce the cash price of travel.

User Story Name: Create travel credit after eligible servicing event
User Story Description: As a customer, I want eligible unused value converted into a travel credit so that I can apply it to future travel.

User Story Name: Validate travel credit rules at checkout
User Story Description: As a customer, I want the platform to validate credit ownership, balance, expiration, and currency before applying it to a booking.

User Story Name: Prevent duplicate voucher redemption
User Story Description: As the airline, I want voucher usage to be idempotent so that a voucher cannot be redeemed more than allowed.

User Story Name: Request wheelchair assistance
User Story Description: As a traveler requiring mobility support, I want to request wheelchair assistance so that airport teams can prepare for my journey.

User Story Name: Add special meal request
User Story Description: As an eligible traveler, I want to request a special meal so that my dietary preference is recorded for the flight.

User Story Name: Purchase priority boarding and lounge access
User Story Description: As a traveler, I want to purchase eligible airport ancillaries so that I can improve my pre-flight experience.

User Story Name: Build multi-city itinerary
User Story Description: As a traveler, I want to search and book multiple flight legs across different cities so that complex trips can be purchased in one reservation.

User Story Name: Validate passport and international document data
User Story Description: As an international traveler, I want required document fields validated so that incomplete information is caught before travel.

User Story Name: Display international travel requirements
User Story Description: As a traveler, I want destination-specific document and travel requirement information so that I can prepare for an international trip.

User Story Name: Retrieve booking using confirmation details
User Story Description: As a customer, I want to retrieve my reservation using confirmation and traveler details so that I can manage an existing trip.

User Story Name: Update booking contact information
User Story Description: As a customer, I want to update email and phone details on an eligible reservation so that operational notifications reach me.

User Story Name: Modify eligible itinerary segments
User Story Description: As a customer, I want to change eligible flights and see any fare difference so that I can service my trip without calling support.

User Story Name: Consume gate change events
User Story Description: As a traveler, I want gate changes from airport operations reflected quickly so that my itinerary shows the correct departure gate.

User Story Name: Display boarding group and boarding status
User Story Description: As a passenger, I want boarding group and current boarding status displayed so that I know when to approach the gate.

User Story Name: Send final boarding call notification
User Story Description: As a passenger, I want a final-call alert when boarding is closing so that I have an opportunity to reach the gate.

User Story Name: Search customer bookings for support
User Story Description: As a support agent, I want to find bookings using confirmation, customer, or flight information so that I can quickly locate a travel case.

User Story Name: View consolidated servicing context
User Story Description: As a support agent, I want payment, refund, disruption, and baggage history in one view so that I can understand the customer's issue.

User Story Name: Perform controlled booking servicing actions
User Story Description: As an authorized support agent, I want permitted rebooking and refund actions with audit history so that customer issues can be resolved safely.

User Story Name: Recommend destinations from traveler preferences
User Story Description: As a customer, I want destination suggestions based on saved preferences so that I can discover relevant trips.

User Story Name: Recommend relevant ancillary services
User Story Description: As a traveler, I want relevant baggage, seat, and airport service recommendations so that useful options are easier to discover.

User Story Name: Respect recommendation privacy preferences
User Story Description: As a customer, I want recommendation personalization to honor my privacy choices so that my preferences are respected.

User Story Name: Create fare alert for route and dates
User Story Description: As a customer, I want to save a route, date range, and target price so that the platform can monitor fares for me.

User Story Name: Detect meaningful fare price changes
User Story Description: As a customer, I want the platform to identify significant price decreases so that I am alerted only when the change is useful.

User Story Name: Send fare threshold notification
User Story Description: As a customer, I want a notification when a monitored fare reaches my configured threshold so that I can decide whether to book.

User Story Name: Apply corporate travel policy during search
User Story Description: As a business traveler, I want preferred and out-of-policy options identified so that I can make policy-compliant booking choices.

User Story Name: Capture cost center and business purpose
User Story Description: As a business traveler, I want required accounting information stored with my booking so that expenses can be allocated correctly.

User Story Name: Route out-of-policy booking for approval
User Story Description: As a manager, I want out-of-policy travel requests routed for approval so that exceptions are controlled.

User Story Name: Trace booking transaction across services
User Story Description: As an operations engineer, I want a correlation identifier across search, payment, and booking services so that failures can be diagnosed end to end.

User Story Name: Monitor payment and booking reliability metrics
User Story Description: As an operations engineer, I want dashboards for payment authorization, booking creation, retries, and latency so that degradation is detected quickly.

User Story Name: Alert on critical booking failures
User Story Description: As an operations engineer, I want actionable alerts for elevated booking and payment failures so that production incidents can be investigated promptly.
